title: Insulin Pump Program Scheduling Rule: Length of an Infusion-Set Refill
content:
This scheduling rule fixes how many 30-day blocks an infusion-set (A4224) refill on an Insulin Pump Program covers, from the age of the pump on the program and the end of the program's infusion-set authorization.

## Rule

| Condition on the ship date | Effect on the standard 30-day blocks |
|---|---|
| The pump on the program was delivered fewer than 90 days before the ship date (the new-pump start days) | the standard blocks are replaced with one 30-day block |
| The pump was delivered at least 90 days before the ship date, and the newest authorization grant for infusion sets covers fewer days than the standard set refill period, counting from the ship date through the grant's valid-through date with both days included | the standard blocks are replaced with the whole 30-day blocks within those days, any part block dropped |
| Neither of the above | the standard blocks stand |

The pump's age is counted in calendar days from the pump delivery date on the program to the ship date. The newest authorization grant for infusion sets is the A4224 grant of the program with the latest valid-from date. The standard set refill period is the tier's supply days per shipment divided by 30.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; tier shipping 90 days per shipment)

| Pump delivered | Days the newest infusion-set grant covers from the ship date, both days included | Blocks |
|---|---|---|
| 89 days before the ship date | any | replaced with 1 |
| 90 days before the ship date | 120 | standard blocks stand |
| 200 days before the ship date | 89 | replaced with 2 (the remaining 29 days are a part block, dropped) |
| 200 days before the ship date | 90 | standard blocks stand — 90 days is not fewer than 90 |
| 200 days before the ship date | 59 | replaced with 1 |
